<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_reference.py from the help of the huron CLI. After you change the help, run `uv run python scripts/cli_reference.py`. -->

Set the schema override of a collection, the settings of a namespace or the share group of a catalog.

Panel: [Manage](/docs/reference/cli/panels/manage/).

## Usage

```text
huron set [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command                                       | Description                                                                            |
| --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`huron set override`](#huron-set-override)   | Set the schema override of the collection. Send the metadata draft too, if one exists. |
| [`huron set namespace`](#huron-set-namespace) | Allow or forbid collections in a namespace. The mode of its directory stays the same.  |
| [`huron set catalog`](#huron-set-catalog)     | Change the share group of a catalog (Org Admin).                                       |

## `huron set override`

Set the schema override of the collection. Send the metadata draft too, if one exists.

```text
huron set override [OPTIONS] FILE [IDENTIFIER]
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                            |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `FILE`       | path | A JSON Schema document. Required.      |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | The default is the current collection. |

## `huron set namespace`

Allow or forbid collections in a namespace. The mode of its directory stays the same.

```text
huron set namespace [OPTIONS] IDENTIFIER
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                             |
| ------------ | ---- | --------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | `catalog.namespace[.child…]`. Required. |

### Options

| Option                                           | Type    | Default | Description                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--allow-collections` / `--no-allow-collections` | boolean |         | Allow or forbid collections in this namespace. Required. |

## `huron set catalog`

Change the share group of a catalog (Org Admin).

The API tries to give the catalog directory the share group. When you clear the share group,
the API tries to give the directory the group of the service. If the API cannot set the
group, the storage administrator must set the group.

```text
huron set catalog [OPTIONS] CATALOG
```

### Arguments

| Argument  | Type | Description                        |
| --------- | ---- | ---------------------------------- |
| `CATALOG` | str  | The name of the catalog. Required. |

### Options

| Option             | Type | Default | Description                                                   |
| ------------------ | ---- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--share-group`    | str  |         | The POSIX group whose members can read the catalog directory. |
| `--no-share-group` | flag |         | Clear the share group of the catalog.                         |
